How we help

What we check after you send a product

We keep it simple. We check if the product, price, packing, and profit look practical for Amazon India.

🔍

Product check

We look at what the product is, who may buy it, and if it looks useful.

🏷️

Price check

We compare your price with similar products on Amazon India.

💰

Profit check

We check buying cost, Amazon charges, packing, ads, returns, and tax.

📦

Packing check

We see if the product needs better photos, packing, or presentation.

✅

Next step

If the product looks good, we tell you what to do next.

⚠️

Honest answer

If the product looks risky, we will tell you clearly. No false promise.

Questions

Common questions

Simple answers for customers and product owners.

What can I do on this page?

You can buy Tuberose & Co. products on Amazon India. You can also send your own product details for review.

I want to buy jewellery. What should I click?

Click any product card or click “Open Amazon store.” The product will open on Amazon India.

I have a product. What should I do?

Fill the form with your name, phone number, product type, buying cost, selling price, and product link or photo if you have one.

Will you accept every product?

No. We first check the product, price, packing, profit, and risk. If it does not look suitable, we will tell you.

Do I need product photos?

Photos are helpful, but not required. You can submit the basic details first.

Does the profit calculator guarantee profit?

No. It is only a rough estimate. Final profit depends on Amazon charges, tax, ads, returns, product cost, and selling price.

How can I contact you quickly?

You can use the form, email info@tentwotechnologies.com, or WhatsApp us at +91 90592 91261.
